meta.title: fix: memoization for markdown components
meta.body_summary: Improve memoization of markdown components by checking type and tagName in areNodesEqual, excluding position and data properties, and adding unit tests.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex improved memoization with type/tag checks and property exclusion; PR closed due to stale branch, changes migrated to new PR #2158.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 98 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits the pattern of a small-step frontend performance fix and the closure (due to branch conflicts, not change quality) is not reflective of the change size.

review_details.concern_detail: Multiple bot reviews flagged that JSON.stringify for property/children comparison misses deep changes, and excluding `data` property could break memoization for plugins. A human reviewer noted vitest in dependencies instead of devDependencies. No formal CHANGES_REQUESTED block was raised.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve memoization of markdown components by checking type and tagName, excluding position and data properties to prevent false negatives in areNodesEqual and reduce unnecessary re-renders.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author closed PR citing branch conflicts and migrated changes to a new PR #2158; no maintainer rejection.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent successfully delivered memoization fix with unit tests, but merge failed due to stale branch; human restarted in a new PR. The capability boundary is process-related rather than technical.

detection_detail.code_reading: The author (likely aided by Codex) identified that areNodesEqual returned false for identical nodes due to position metadata, leading to unnecessary re-renders; the fix explicitly ignores position and data.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Unit tests verify memoization correctness, but no before/after performance benchmarks or profiling data are provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed and the changes were carried over to a new PR (#2158) due to branch conflicts; no regression occurred on the main branch.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored areNodesEqual in memoization.tsx to compare type and tagName, and to exclude position and data from property comparison via a custom sanitize/excludeMetadata function. Added unit tests for areNodesEqual covering type mismatches, tag mismatches, position exclusion, and children differences.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Secondary files include new test suite and vitest configuration, package.json scripts, lockfile update, and a minor CSS formatting fix.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added areNodesEqual tests, updated memoization logic with type/tag checks and position exclusion, vitest setup.
Second commit: renamed sanitize to excludeMetadata and also excluded data property.
Subsequent commit(s): ran prettier on test file and CSS to fix formatting; final state before closure.

review_signals.summary: JSON.stringify can be inconsistent for object comparison due to key ordering; consider deep equality.
Using JSON.stringify for deep comparison can be costly on large objects; consider a targeted deep-equality helper.
vitest should be in devDependencies, not dependencies.
Prettier formatting check failed; run prettier --write.
areNodesEqual performs shallow comparison; changes in nested objects or function props are missed.
Closing PR because updating locally is breaking GitButler; merging these changes in a new PR #2158.
review_signals.action_taken: PR closed; changes migrated to new PR.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with memoization fix and unit tests; multiple bot reviews appeared within minutes flagging JSON.stringify and shallow comparison issues.
Author converted to draft, later pushed a commit to also exclude data and rename sanitize.
After prettier formatting and re‑ready, author eventually closed PR citing branch conflicts, with explicit intent to merge via new PR.
